citation.authors: Sorola S, Hyrylä V, Eronen T, Kupari S, Venojärvi M, Tikkanen H, Tarvainen M, Lindholm H
citation.title: Orthostatic test shows higher systolic blood pressure and sympathetic response in uncomplicated type 1 diabetes patients with normal V̇O2max vs. healthy controls

population.description: Healthy control group (CON) of the study, n = 31 (15 women, 16 men). The paper calls them healthy controls: no diagnosed chronic illness, no cardiovascular medication, not smoking, and no known coronary disease (Methods, 'Study participants'). Age 33 +/- 7 years and BMI 24.2 +/- 3.1 kg/m2 are the CON column of Table 1 (mean +/- SD); the paper prints no minimum or maximum, so they are null. The type 1 diabetes group is not used. Control V̇O2max is 40.2 +/- 7.6 mL/min/kg (Table 1), a fitness descriptor of the group, not a finding; the groups were matched for it.

protocols.name: supine_rest
protocols.description: Healthy controls lying supine for the 5-min supine rest of the passive orthostatic test, before the 5-s table tilt to 70 degrees. The blood pressure is read at the end of the rest, just before the tilt (Methods, 'Experimental protocol'), so it is minute 5 of the arm: duration_min 6 = the 5-min rest plus the state at minute 5. The rest is preceded by a 5-min seated rest and a 1-min paced deep-breathing test ending 30 to 60 s before the supine rest; neither is modelled. Fed state: the paper says only that participants were to 'consume a normal breakfast and a small lunch if necessary', with tests between 7 AM and 2 PM; the breakfast time and contents are not printed, so no meal is entered and the arm starts from typical values (norm_center). Clock hour not printed; 8.0 assumed.

findings.description: Systolic BP of the healthy controls at the end of the 5-min supine rest, before the tilt (one reading at minute 5 of the arm; window is that minute). Mean +/- SD, n = 31. Control column only.
